'''Syun Nagguth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Genarius]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], working as a parade [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]]. Following the release of the gas [[Trinex-M]] in the [[City/Legends|city]], Syun was driven cataleptic, and his son, [[Neb Nagguth]], stole Syun's [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]].
